## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes or improves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] Automated tests (`python -m unittest discover tests`)
- [ ] Manual testing with live Pi-hole instance
- [ ] Docker container build verified

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where appropriate
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
